hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.css|*.json) [ -f "$f" ] && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm exec biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.mjs|*.yaml|*.json) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; out=$(node scripts/doctor.mjs --drift 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
